Container.Name: Shelfwright
Container.Overview: Audiobook library upkeep: finds problems in your audiobook library, Audiobookshelf and (optionally) Chaptarr and proposes fixes. You approve them in the web UI. Safe fixes (tag sync, dramatized formatting, Chaptarr author folders, empty folders) can run on their own. Also converts multi-file and MP3 books to m4b with Audiobookshelf's own encoder.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web UI

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: The audiobook library (the same folder ABS uses for its library)

Config.Name: ABS config (read-only)
Config.Description: Holds absdatabase.sqlite. It is copied before reading, never opened live.

Config.Name: ABS metadata
Config.Description: Where ABS keeps the original tracks after an m4b encode (cache/items)

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Findings database, logs, backups and trash

Config.Name: ABS_URL
Config.Description: Audiobookshelf URL

Config.Name: ABS_TOKEN
Config.Description: Audiobookshelf API key (an admin key)

Config.Name: ABS_LIBRARY_ID
Config.Description: ABS library id (Settings → Libraries, or /api/libraries)

Config.Name: ABS_LIB_ROOT
Config.Description: The library folder as the Audiobookshelf container sees it

Config.Name: CHAPTARR_LIB_ROOT
Config.Description: The library folder as the Chaptarr container sees it (Chaptarr checks are off when empty)

Config.Name: CHAPTARR_URL
Config.Description: Chaptarr URL

Config.Name: CHAPTARR_KEY
Config.Description: Chaptarr API key (config.xml ApiKey)

Config.Name: PG_HOST
Config.Description: Chaptarr's Postgres host

Config.Name: PG_USER
Config.Description: Chaptarr's Postgres user

Config.Name: PG_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Chaptarr's Postgres password (config.xml PostgresPassword). Empty = Chaptarr checks skipped.

Config.Name: PG_DB
Config.Description: Chaptarr's main database

Config.Name: AUTO_APPLY_SAFE
Config.Description: true = safe fixes run on their own after each scan

Config.Name: SCAN_INTERVAL_HOURS
Config.Description: Hours between automatic scans

Config.Name: CONVERT_REENCODE
Config.Description: true = also propose MP3/Ogg books for conversion. These need a re-encode to AAC (a small quality loss). AAC books are always joined losslessly.

Config.Name: CONVERT_MAX_BITRATE
Config.Description: Re-encodes only: highest AAC bitrate in kbps. 0 = no cap (the source bitrate, rounded up).

Config.Name: BACKUP_KEEP_DAYS
Config.Description: Days before the originals ABS kept after a conversion are offered for deletion

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone
